_comment: Scored-turn replay of `docpilot eval --gate-only` at DOCPILOT_ANTECEDENT_HOPS=1, computed offline from the committed query-side embed cache. Not a CLI run: the CLI also embeds every PRIMING turn, and those vectors were never cached. See the header of scripts/replay-floor-hops1.mjs for why the priming cascade cannot move any number in this file at hops=1, and for how the replay is validated against the CLI.
